jobs.title: PCS Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

PCS Project Manager

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Responsibilities include:

For allocated projects, upon handover from the Illingworth Global Project Start-Up (GPSU)

team be the first point of contact for both CRO (Contract Research Organisation) and sponsor

clients, project issues, heads of trial sites, vendors, and Illingworth business units and functions,

liaising with the AD PCS and Senior Director of PCS for issue management and resolution.

Be responsible for the day-to-day oversight and close out of allocated patient concierge

projects and to liaise with the PCS Coordination team, Finance, and IT (INFORMATION

TECHNOLOGY), delivering the project until completion in accordance with the appropriate

clinical SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), GCP (Good Clinical Practice) and all applicable

regulatory requirements.

Provide project specific training to the PCS coordinators assigned to the team and oversee

their project work.

Attend project handover meetings from GPSU and kick-off meetings where necessary with

clients, gaining an understanding of the study indication, patient demographic, project budget,

PCS deliverables and timelines.

Work with the PCS Concierge Coordinators (PCS PCCs) to arrange the set-up of the trial

environment within the PatientGO® portal.

Lead the process of document creation and translation for site and ethics ready patient facing

material, in conjunction with the global start-up team. Give guidance to the client on Travel and

Expense Reimbursement Policy set-up and management, with the aim to minimise patient

burden and maximise the potential of their retention.

Develop a clear understanding of the study budget and its scope, managing it to the point of

completion and reconciliation. Prepare accurate financial and activity forecasts for the lifetime of

the project and report actual performance against forecast. Prepare monthly invoices based on

project activity. Identify changes in scope and seek client approval for change orders.

Manage external vendors providing services to the project ensuring they meet Service Level

Agreements and other contractual agreements.

Conduct monthly project reviews and report progress identifying achievements and issues with

overall study progress, finances, client relationships, project risks, resource, and vendors. Attend

project review meetings as required and escalate issues to Senior Management.

Work to generate opportunities for collaboration with Illingworth's Research Nursing and

Medical Imaging divisions, to help deliver holistic solutions for the benefit of clients and their

patients.

Stay informed on the requirements of your role, the industry and challenges faced by patients

and clients across the therapeutic areas PCS supports, identifying personal development

opportunities and training needs for you and your colleagues. Maintain and share knowledge of

all relevant guidance, regulations, and procedures with other PCS team members to ensure best

practice.

Work with PCS PCC team to set up and distribute expense reimbursement materials and

patient welcome packs and lead the creation of new content where necessary.

Maintain effective project related communications between the other Illingworth business units,

clients, clinical trial sites and vendors to ensure excellent relationships continue and all parties

are kept up to date with project progress. This includes sending invitations, leading meetings,

and taking notes of discussion points and actions to share with attendees post-meeting in a

timely manner. In the event that PCS is collaborating on a project with IRG's Research Nursing

(RN) division, coordinate with RN Project Leads to ensure a ‘joined-up' approach for the client.

Review and approve project timesheets, comparing work completed against visit trackers and

budget allowances, requesting team members to correct entries where required.

Participate in possible face-to-face client and vendor related meetings, these will require travel

both home and abroad.

Working with the Director of Patient Concierge Services and Business Development to develop

and grow the service and team.

Retain the lead whilst working closely with the PCS Commercial Manager to ensure all change

orders are executed in a timely and efficient manner.

Ensure that assigned projects centrally stored oversight trackers are complete and up to date

always, to ensure appropriate business continuity measures are met.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Job Description Summary

About the Role

Join our Grid Automation team as a Lead Project Manager, where you'll take ownership of complex, high-impact projects across our Protection Relays, Substation & Distribution Automation, Monitoring & Diagnosis, and Systems & Services portfolio. You'll manage execution from tender through warranty close-out, acting as the primary point of contact for customers and driving results across safety, quality, scope, cost, schedule, and risk.

This role offers the opportunity to manage multiple parallel projects, build lasting customer relationships, and shape how our Operations team continuously improves.

Job Description

What You'll Do

Lead project execution from tender through warranty end, serving as the primary customer contact for contract delivery
Build and sustain strong, long-term customer relationships through clear and proactive communication
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, contract administration, contract management, finance, and procurement to deliver projects on time and on budget
Own on-time delivery, sales and cash-in realization, forecast accuracy, risk management, and customer satisfaction for your project portfolio
Apply project management best practices per the Project Management Handbook and relevant product line guidance
Provide monthly updates on action plans and sales/cash forecasts
Prepare and present project reviews to stakeholders
Contribute to Operations team development and continuous improvement initiatives
Champion EHS/safety performance; ensure your team (including subcontractors) is trained and holds required qualifications
Uphold company compliance standards and promote a culture of open reporting
Support the Commercial team during pre-contract activities, sharing lessons learned to optimize project costs and delivery

What You'll Bring (Required)

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree (minimum 6 years)
5+ years of experience in electricity grid engineering or project management
Ability and willingness to travel approximately 20% of the time, in compliance with company travel and tax policies

Nice to Have

Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies
Strong written and oral communication skills; fluency in English
Experience leading and motivating project teams with autonomy and rigor
Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering
Experience working in multicultural environments (international assignment experience a plus)
PMP certification
Experience managing customer-facing projects in electricity transmission, distribution, or industrial markets
Technical and business knowledge in Digital Substation, Protection, and Control
Strong leadership, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills
Familiarity with contract terms and contract management
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Proven ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple concurrent projects

Work Arrangement & Location

Remote – Utah preferred. No relocation assistance is provided for this role. This position requires approximately 20% travel to customer sites and other project locations.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The incumbent is a key member of the Operations team and is responsible for developing localization solutions and workflows, timely and accurate completion of projects, working closely with Client Managers to maximize revenue opportunities, and building long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with clients. While filling a leadership role in the company, the Senior PM may serve as a mentor to Project Managers and provide project supervision over one or more Project Managers.

The incumbent is expected to exercise initiative, discretion and independent judgment in the administration and management of each client relationship, and will serve as a primary point of contact for the client. The Senior Project Manager position is critical to the overall success of the company

It is essential for the Senior Project Managers to build, develop, and nurture relationships with the client and in-house staff to ensure that their requirements are met, and that localized projects deliver on time, within budget, and to acceptable standards. Good communication abilities are needed to deal with the large number of concurrent activities and people that are involved in servicing the client.

Primary Duties

Build strong personal relationship with current and prospective clients.
Identify new business opportunities from existing clients and communicate them to the Sales team.
Develop and execute solutions for current and prospective clients.
Support the Sales team as needed to help close new business opportunities.
Maintain close contact with the client whenever an issue is at stake to ensure proper resolution.
Provide management with feedback and recommendations on necessary changes to streamline and or improve the company's processes, procedures, and services.
Provide supervision and mentoring and/or manage Project Managers and Project Coordinators.
Work with the Sales team and Project Managers to develop a schedule for projects and assure adequate communication lines are used during projects.
Maintain and update key LanguageLine business systems, such as WorkFront, LLTS Wiki, and other DB's to note all relevant client communications
Represent LanguageLine at trade shows, expositions, and conferences when necessary.
Conduct visits to current and (possibly) prospective clients.
Contribute to the Process and Quality Improvement Initiative by participating on cross- functional teams.
Arrange and assign linguists for projects.
Within the project scope, manage the relationships with linguists to encourage cooperation.
Manage contractors to ensure their delivery of product on time.
Monitor quality control procedures to ensure that all quality checks are completed.
Consistently track projects; report status and key issues to Account Executives.
Ensure that projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with the required level of quality.
Communicate directly with clients concerning all manner of project-related activity, including change order parameters and project status.
Authorize and sign-off on projects being delivered to clients. Ensure that projects are delivered to the clients' specifications and expectations, and in a manner befitting to a world-class organization.
Provide training and consulting services to Project Managers and participate as a consultant for systems development activities.
Other duties as may be assigned by the, President, Operations Manager, Director of Engineering or Translation Manager.

Requirements

Knowledge of MS Word suite (Word, Excel, PPT, Outlook)
Thorough knowledge of project management fundamentals as they apply to the localization industry.
Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to multi-task.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Foreign language skills a plus.

Appropriate Education And Experience

A minimum of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
Hands-on knowledge of database functions and concepts.
Must be very resourceful, with the ability to work independently.
Must have proven organizational and communication skills.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, iQueue for Inpatient Flow
jobs.description:
We are a growth stage company that creates software solutions combining lean principles, predictive and prescriptive analytics, and machine learning to transform hospital and infusion center operations. More than 190 health systems and over 1,200 hospitals and centers across 49 states rely on our award-winning products and expert change management services to increase patient access, decrease wait times, and reduce healthcare delivery costs. We have raised more than $300 million from top-tier investors such as Bain Capital, Insight Partners, and Goldman Sachs. We have been named among the top 100 AI companies in the world.

Please note that while this role is listed as available for remote, we are currently employing in the following states: AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV. If your state is not listed, we may not be able to proceed with your application. We have offices in Santa Clara, CA and Charlotte, NC for employees who prefer to work regularly or occasionally from an office.

Join our Customer Onboarding team, where we partner with hospitals and health systems to implement technology that improves patient flow, optimizes capacity, and helps patients get the right care at the right time.

As a Senior Program Manager supporting Inpatient Flow, you will own healthcare technology implementations from pre-kickoff through go-live, serving as the primary driver of the project plan and day-to-day execution. You will bring together customer and LeanTaaS teams to manage the many interconnected pieces of a successful implementation—from discovery and technical readiness to workflow alignment, testing, training, go-live preparation, and launch.

You will build and manage detailed project plans, drive customer meetings and decisions, coordinate clinical and technical workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure teams remain aligned and accountable to their commitments. You’ll anticipate what could impact the implementation, create clear paths to resolution, and keep customers and internal stakeholders informed and moving forward.

Our implementations range from individual hospitals to complex, enterprise-wide deployments spanning multiple workflows, facilities, and stakeholder groups. You will partner closely with Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers, Product Implementation, Data Engineering, Customer Success and customer teams to bring structure and accountability to each engagement and ensure customers are prepared for a successful go-live.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead Customer Implementations

Own and lead a portfolio of complex Inpatient Flow implementations from kickoff through go-live and transition to Customer Success
Build, maintain, and execute detailed implementation plans, including milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resources, decisions, and timelines
Lead implementations that span multiple workflows in multiple hospitals across a health system
Run customer and internal implementation meetings, establish clear action items and owners, and drive accountability for commitments across customer and LeanTaaS teams
Coordinate discovery, technical implementation, workflow design, training, testing, readiness, and go-live activities across all implementation workstreams
Maintain implementation momentum by proactively following up on deliverables, resolving blockers, and ensuring decisions are made when needed
Drive high-quality implementations by ensuring consistent execution against established standards, proactively identifying gaps, and maintaining a high bar for customer experience and delivery excellence
Coordinate and participate in onsite meetings and activities

Manage Risk, Dependencies & Escalations

Continuously assess implementation health and proactively identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and decisions that could impact delivery
Develop and drive mitigation plans before risks become implementation delays or customer escalations
Identify and escalate issues requiring additional leadership, product, technical, or clinical support and ensure they remain actively managed through resolution
Manage changes to implementation scope and timelines, clearly communicating impacts and establishing alignment on the path forward
Maintain clear documentation of decisions, risks, action items, dependencies, and customer commitments throughout the implementation
Provide internal and customer stakeholders with clear, consistent visibility into implementation status, risks, accomplishments, and next steps

Drive Customer & Cross-Functional Alignment

Build strong working relationships with customer project leaders, executives, clinical leaders, operational stakeholders, and technical teams
Facilitate customer governance and implementation meetings that drive decisions, resolve open issues, and maintain alignment across stakeholders
Partner closely with Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers to incorporate workflow transformation, change management, training, and adoption activities into the overall implementation plan
Coordinate across Product Implementation, Data Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and other LeanTaaS teams to ensure workstreams and dependencies remain aligned
Navigate competing priorities and differing stakeholder perspectives while maintaining focus on implementation goals and customer outcomes
Ensure a thorough handoff to Customer Success at the completion of implementation, including outcomes, open items, commitments, risks, and opportunities for continued optimization
Understand the overall implementation strategy and translate it into a delivery approach that aligns project execution with customer needs, implementation goals, and desired business outcomes

Contribute to Implementation Excellence

Apply established implementation methodologies, tools, and best practices consistently across customer engagements
Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, templates, tools, and documentation based on lessons learned from customer engagements
Share implementation insights and best practices with the broader team to improve consistency and execution across future implementations

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent years of related experience) in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
5+ years of hands-on project or program management experience leading complex healthcare implementations
Experience directly managing implementations through the full lifecycle, from kickoff and discovery through testing, training, go-live, and transition
Experience leading health system-wide initiatives involving multiple hospitals, workstreams, stakeholder groups, or technology solutions
Strong project management fundamentals, including project planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, issue management, scope management, and stakeholder communication
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
Proven ability to drive accountability and results across cross-functional teams without direct authority
Experience working directly with executives, clinical leaders, operational teams, technical teams, and project stakeholders within hospitals or health systems
Ability to translate complex implementation details into clear project plans, decisions, risks, and next steps
Strong communication, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies
Resourceful, results-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment
Willingness to travel 30–40% of the time

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

Experience implementing enterprise healthcare technology or SaaS solutions
Experience with inpatient hospital operations, patient flow, capacity management, or related operational workflows
Experience managing multi-product or multi-site implementations across large health systems
Experience working in JIRA and Smartsheet
Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or other process improvement training or certification

WHAT YOU'LL GET

Intellectual and emotional satisfaction of solving tough operational problems in healthcare while improving patient access and saving lives!
Competitive compensation package that includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options
401(k) Match
Comprehensive healthcare benefits
Generous Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
Monthly reimbursement for Skill Building
Monthly reimbursement for Wellness, Transportation, and/or Home Office
Education Reimbursement for select courses/programs

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Program Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a
Senior Cybersecurity Program Manager

This role is
Remote, Canada

The Sr. Cybersecurity Program Manager is a critical business and compliance role
responsible for operational governance, customer assurance, audit readiness, and continuous monitoring of Cornerstone public sector cloud offerings in Canada and the United States. The role leads and coordinates activities supporting Government of Canada Protected B services, FedRAMP Moderate, and the AWS GovCloud / DoD Impact Level 4 (IL4) environment.

The successful candidate ensures authorization commitments are translated into sustainable operating processes, clearly assigned ownership, timely evidence, effective remediation, and transparent government and executive reporting. The role coordinates annual assessments, continuous monitoring, POA&M management, vulnerability governance, corrective action plans, audit evidence, control-owner accountability, customer onboarding readiness, and development of the Cornerstone Protected B solution. This role will support the overall vision of the Cybersecurity Program at Cornerstone OnDemand. This position is part of the global Cybersecurity Engineering and Assurance team and reports to the Sr. Director, Quality & Risk Management.

In this role you will...

Public Sector Program Leadership

Own the integrated cybersecurity program plan, governance cadence, milestones, dependencies, risks, and executive reporting for Protected B, FedRAMP Moderate, and DoD IL4 initiatives.
Serve as a senior program interface across Cybersecurity, Quality & Risk Management, Cloud Operations, Engineering, Product, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, external assessors, government sponsors, and authorizing organizations.
Maintain clear RACI assignments, named control owners, backup coverage, decision logs, risk acceptance records, and escalation paths to avoid single points of failure.
Translate regulatory, authorization, contractual, and customer requirements into actionable work plans and measurable operational outcomes.

Protected B - Canada

Lead cybersecurity program management for existing Protected B services and development, readiness, and operationalization of the Cornerstone Protected B solution.
Coordinate alignment with Government of Canada security expectations, including ITSG-33 risk management practices, applicable cloud control requirements, security assessment and authorization activities, and continuous monitoring.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager
(Remote, Latin America, full-time contract)

We’re hiring our first Technical Project Manager. We’re looking for someone who has led CRM, automation or software builds and can tell when an estimate is fiction. You’d run delivery at a small US firm where good work gets seen and used.

You’ll run day-to-day delivery on our client builds and AI engagements, under our Operations Director. That means the sprint, the client updates and the standard the work is held to.

Who we are

Revflow designs and installs operating systems for growth-stage companies. That means revenue systems (how opportunities enter and close) and operations systems (how work moves from intake through delivery to payment). Our clients are founder-led companies where too much still runs through one person. We design the system first, choose the tools that serve it, then put AI and automation to work inside it. We build with the client’s team, not for it, so the system keeps running after we step back. Our method is Diagnose, Design, Deploy.

We’re based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, and work remotely. Our Operations Director works from Latin America too.

What the work looks like

Recent work includes:

A revenue and operations system build for an industrial coatings company
An AI estimating workflow for the same company, plus AI training for its team
A solar detection web app for an energy company
An executive coaching dashboard for a leadership coaching firm

Day to day, that means CRM and pipeline setup, intake-to-delivery workflows, automations, integrations between systems, dashboards, and AI tools the client’s team actually uses. You’ll usually run several builds at once, across different industries.

What you’ll own

The sprint.
Planning, standups, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives, at the cadence each build needs.
The client updates.
Run the day-to-day meetings on your builds, set expectations, and give the hard update early rather than the comfortable one late.
The build itself.
Build and test smaller pieces yourself. Lead our developers and subcontractors on the bigger ones, and hold everyone, the client included, to what they committed to.
Scope.
Spot a change, write it up, and bring it to the Operations Director so it’s scoped and priced before anyone starts on it.
Blockers.
Find what’s slowing the work and clear it. Escalate early when a call is above your line.
Visibility and records.
Keep progress, risk and delivery health readable in two minutes. Keep decision logs and documentation, because if a decision isn’t written down, it didn’t happen.
Adoption.
Track whether the client’s team actually uses what we built. Adoption is the metric, not speed.
How we deliver.
Find the waste in our own delivery process and take it out. You’ll help write our delivery playbook, then run it.

You’re likely a fit if

You’ve led technical projects: CRM, automation, integration or software builds. You understood the work well enough to plan it, test it and unblock it, and you’re comfortable working hands-on in CRM and automation platforms. HighLevel experience is a plus.
You’re detail-driven and you follow through. Nothing falls through the cracks on your projects.
You’ve owned projects from start to finish (scope, timeline, risk and stakeholders), not only tracked them.
You’ve run real sprints, and you know when to hold the ceremony and when to bend it.
You’ve worked directly with clients, and you can deliver bad news well.
Your written and spoken English is excellent, at a professional, client-facing level.
You believe process is a form of care, not bureaucracy.

It’s a bonus if

You’ve applied Lean Six Sigma or another structured improvement method to real work. We care more about the process you fixed than the belt you hold.
You’ve worked in or with manufacturing, construction and trades, building products, or professional services.
You’ve built a delivery process from nothing and gotten a team to adopt it.
You know EOS or a similar operating framework from the inside.
You already use AI in your own work, tied to real outcomes rather than novelty.

What you get

A direct, long-term, full-time contract with Revflow, paid in USD.
Hands-on technical work across different industries, with AI and automation built into what we deliver.
Direct work with US founders and their teams, not a ticket queue.
The first project management seat at a growing firm. You’ll shape how delivery runs here instead of inheriting someone else’s rules.
A small team where your work is visible. You’ll report to our Operations Director and work alongside our Founder and CEO.

This probably isn’t for you if

You manage projects from a dashboard and prefer to stay out of the build.
You need an established playbook on day one. You’ll help write it.
You want one account and a predictable rhythm.
You want to be measured on velocity. We measure whether the client’s business runs better.

Your first 90 days

Days 1 to 30:
Learn the method and the accounts. Sit inside active builds, meet every client, and read every project record we have. Then tell us where the records are thin.
Days 31 to 60:
Take day-to-day ownership of a live build. Run the sprint and the client updates, and escalate early while you’re calibrating.
Days 61 to 90:
Tell us where our delivery process leaks, what you’d standardize and what you’d measure. Then start installing it.

By day 90, the Operations Director should no longer be the single point of coordination on every build.

How to apply

With your application, send two or three paragraphs in English about one build you led: what it was, what went wrong, and what you did about it. It tells us more than a résumé does.
Pay is in USD, and we talk about it openly on the first call. We’d rather find out in twenty minutes whether we’re in the same range than spend three weeks discovering we’re not.

Connect client objectives with our team’s process, setting clear expectations on both sides so ambitious ideas stay on time and on budget.

The Self-Starter:
You thrive in an environment that prizes autonomy and intentionality across a variety of workstreams. You see the next move and take it before being asked.

We are built on trust and talent. We’ve stripped away the unnecessary layers of the traditional agency model to focus on what matters: the ideas and the people who make them. This is a 6 month contract position.

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there's one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform.

Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win-win-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams.

What You'll Be Doing

Co-Marketing Execution

Support and execute partner co-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in-product placements, and live events.
Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time-to-launch across partners.
Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review.
Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables.

Cross-Functional Program Coordination

Provide day-to-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always-on promotions running smoothly.
Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner-facing programs.
Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders.
Maintain intake and request-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently.
Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification).
Help coordinate partner workshops, innovation days, QBR presentations, and industry summits, using established frameworks and templates.

Reporting & Optimization

Track campaign performance against business KPIs — including revenue supported, daily account linked players (DALP), and Commerce GMV — and help synthesize insights for the team.
Help maintain a partner marketing roadmap that shows program activity and status for cross-functional visibility.
Flag recurring friction points (e.g., one-off approval requests, low-priority asks) to help the team improve processes over time.

What you should have

Experience

5–6 years of experience in partner marketing, co-marketing, marketing operations, or program/project coordination — ideally in a tech, gaming, or platform company.
Experience supporting cross-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting.
Some experience working directly with external partners or clients in a marketing capacity.

Skills

Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks.
Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others.
Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage an asset tracker or partner approval request end-to-end.
Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.
Good analytical instincts — comfortable pulling data and connecting program activity to business metrics with guidance.

Tools

Proficiency in project management and workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Salesforce, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude / AI).
Familiarity with cross-functional marketing operations, including intake and approval workflows.
Experience with presentation-heavy environments (Google Slides / PowerPoint) — you'll frequently build and review partner-facing materials.

Bonus Points

Experience in the gaming industry or with game developer partnerships.
Background in or exposure to developer marketing, platform marketing, or B2B marketing.
Familiarity with co-marketing in a deal context — where marketing is part of a larger commercial negotiation.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Implementation Program Manager - Utah

About The Role

Packsize is seeking a Senior Implementation Program Manager to lead complex customer implementations from post-sale kickoff through go-live, stabilization, and formal handoff. This role combines disciplined program management with customer success leadership, ensuring solutions are delivered on time and within budget while preparing customer teams to operate, adopt, and realize sustained value.

What You’ll Do

Lead the customer implementation

Own customer-facing implementation leadership from kickoff through formal closeout and handoff, adapting governance for complex, multi-site, enterprise, or high-risk deployments.
Translate the sold solution and customer requirements into an outcomes-based plan with clear scope, milestones, owners, decision rights, dependencies, and completion criteria.
Build trusted relationships with customer leaders and cross-functional teams, aligning them around critical dates, readiness expectations, decisions, and implementation outcomes.

Drive program execution and risk management

Coordinate with Sales, engineering, Service, Operations, and other partners to confirm requirements and maintain the Implementation Specification Document and integrated implementation plan.
Manage schedules, budgets, costs, customer prerequisites, and cross-functional commitments across multiple concurrent implementations.
Maintain the RAID log, remove roadblocks, and escalate material scope, schedule, technical, customer, or commercial risks with clear recommendations.

Build readiness, adoption, and go-live success

Drive customer readiness across facilities, workflows, staffing, training, materials, systems, and operational support using clear completion criteria.
Lead onboarding, stakeholder alignment, communications, training coordination, and practical change management while surfacing adoption risks early.
Coordinate go/no-go readiness reviews, Customer Acceptance Testing, and go-live execution with transparent risks, owners, and contingency plans.
Lead early-life stabilization and confirm readiness, acceptance, training, and early-adoption outcomes before implementation closeout.

Close, hand off, and improve

Execute a checklist-based handoff documenting the operating state, adoption baseline, open items, risks, named owners, and next-step success plan for ongoing technical and commercial teams.
Provide concise status, decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to customers and Packsize leaders, using influence to align teams and move issues forward.
Complete closeout artifacts and after-action reviews, using root-cause analysis to improve implementation practices, governance, and customer experience.

How Success Will Be Measured

Reliable execution: Milestones, schedule, budget, risks, and escalations are managed effectively.
Customer readiness and adoption: People, processes, facilities, systems, and training are ready for launch and early use.
Successful go-live: Customer acceptance is achieved, operations stabilize, and critical launch issues are closed.
Quality handoff and improvement: Open items and ownership are clearly transferred, with lessons applied to future implementations.

Measures may be tailored to the scope and complexity of the assigned implementation portfolio.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Five or more years of project or program management experience leading complex customer-facing implementations and multiple concurrent priorities.
Demonstrated customer and change leadership, including the ability to build trust, navigate conflict, and influence senior stakeholders and matrixed teams.
Strong technical acumen across hardware, software, integrations, and customer operations, with the curiosity to learn complex solutions quickly.
Clear executive communication and sound judgment, including the ability to translate complex information into decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.
Analytical, customer-centered problem solving with ownership, resilience, and the ability to use KPIs and risk trends to protect implementation outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in business, engineering, organizational change, or a related field.
Experience leading enterprise, Fortune 500, multi-site, or other high-complexity implementations, including budget ownership.
Experience leading customer readiness, onboarding, training, adoption, change management, go-live, and post-launch stabilization.
Experience developing implementation playbooks, readiness checklists, governance routines, executive reporting, and formal handoff practices.
Project, program, or change-management certification and experience with Lean Six Sigma, 5-Why, or similar improvement methods.

jobs.description:
Please Note:
To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

At CesiumAstro
, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Program Manager, Products
to our team. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming customer needs and solution architectures into well-defined, executable programs. Working within the Product Development & Assurance organization, the Senior Program Manager leads program formation from pre-contract solution development through proposal development, contract definitization, and transition to the execution team.

Partnering with Product, Technical Architects, Engineering, Business Development, Finance, Contracts, Supply Chain, and Program Management, the Senior Program Manager, Products translates the “what” of the solution into the “how” of execution. This includes establishing program scope and requirements, development plans, cost and schedule baselines, risks and opportunities, ground rules and assumptions, Make/Buy plans, and the overall program execution baseline.

This role also contributes to product strategy by identifying opportunities to leverage existing or in-development products, distinguishing reusable product capabilities from customer-specific development, and ensuring program decisions align with the company’s broader product roadmap.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Lead program formation. Own the development of the program execution approach from initial solution architecture through proposal, contract award, and transition into execution.
Establish executable program baselines. Develop integrated scope, requirements, cost, schedule, staffing, risk, and resource plans. Establish ground rules and assumptions and ensure the baseline is supported by the technical and business teams responsible for execution.
Translate architecture into execution. Partner with Technical Architects and Engineering to translate solution architectures into development plans, work packages, milestones, deliverables, and integrated program schedules.
Support product strategy and reuse. Evaluate opportunities to leverage existing and in-development products and identify where new reusable capabilities may be required versus customer-specific development. Provide program-level insight to Product leadership to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Drive proposal development. Provide the programmatic and execution content required for customer proposals, including Statements of Work, schedules, cost estimates, risks, assumptions, staffing plans, and execution approaches.
Support contract definitization. Partner with Contracts and business leadership during customer negotiations to ensure scope, requirements, deliverables, schedule, assumptions, and contractual commitments are consistent with the planned execution baseline.
Lead Make/Buy and supplier planning. Coordinate Make/Buy trades with Product, Engineering, and Supply Chain and establish supplier scope, requirements, cost, schedule, and assumptions required to support the program baseline.
Own program readiness and transition. Ensure awarded programs transition into execution with a clear SOW, requirements baseline, budget, integrated schedule, risk register, supplier commitments, ground rules and assumptions, and Program Management Plan.
Support early execution. Remain engaged with the execution Program Manager and Engineering team through transition and early program milestones, including SRR, to resolve gaps between the proposed, contracted, and executable baselines.
Provide program assurance. Identify and drive resolution of technical, cost, schedule, contractual, and execution risks before they become downstream program issues. Ensure commitments made during capture and proposal are understood, achievable, and appropriately baselined.
Integrate across functions. Serve as a central program integration point across Product, Engineering, Business Development, Finance, Contracts, Supply Chain, and execution teams to drive decisions and maintain alignment throughout program formation.

Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business administration, program management, operations management, supply chain management, or a related field with 12–15 years of related experience, Master's degree with 8–12 years of related experience, or PhD with 5–8 years of related experience in program management, project management, engineering, manufacturing, operations, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience establishing and managing scope, requirements, cost, schedule, risk, and execution baselines for complex technical programs.
Proficiency in supporting programs from pre-contract or proposal development through contract award and execution.
Extensive experience collaborating with engineering, finance, contracts, supply chain, and customer-facing organizations to develop and execute integrated program plans.

$193,000 - $236,000 a year

Description

Safety Project Manager

Director, Safety

We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE SAFETY TEAM

Safety is one of our core values at CEI. Our dedicated Safety Department takes a proactive approach, fostering a team-driven culture where every employee is empowered to prioritize safety in every task. We believe in continuous improvement, open communication, and a shared commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment.

About The Role

The Safety Project Manager supports the Safety Directors and the Corporate Safety Team in fostering and sustaining an Incident and Injury Free Culture (IIFC) while ensuring compliance with federal, state, local, and client-specific safety regulations. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, managing, and continuously improving safety programs across the organization.

The Safety Project Manager leads and coordinates safety-related projects by partnering with safety teams, business units, third-party vendors, and key stakeholders. Through strong project management, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, this role drives successful project outcomes, strengthens organizational safety performance, and promotes a proactive safety culture.

Project Management & Program Execution

Lead safety projects from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and business objectives.
Develop detailed project plans, define milestones, assign resources, and monitor progress to ensure successful project delivery.
Coordinate internal and external resources to ensure projects adhere to scope, schedule, and budget requirements.
Communicate project status, outcomes, risks, and issues to stakeholders and leadership teams, escalating concerns when appropriate.
Utilize project management best practices, techniques, and standards throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions as needed to maintain project objectives.

Safety Leadership & Compliance

Partner with internal stakeholders to support safety goals and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with project teams to integrate safety planning into preconstruction activities, field operations, and project closeout processes.
Maintain current knowledge of OSHA regulations, applicable local safety requirements, and industry best practices to ensure organizational compliance.
Promote a culture of accountability, open communication, proactive hazard identification, and risk prevention throughout the organization.
Support and sustain the organization's Incident and Injury Free Culture (IIFC).

Training & Development

Develop, implement, and support safety training programs, policies, and procedures.
Evaluate the effectiveness of safety training programs through assessments, audits, and performance metrics.
Partner closely with operations teams to identify and address new safety training needs.
Provide tools, resources, and guidance that enable field teams to execute effective safety practices.

Stakeholder Management

Establish and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with safety teams, operations leaders, business partners, and vendors to support project success.
Influence and motivate teams to achieve safety and project objectives.
Facilitate effective communication across all levels of the organization.

About You

Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize multiple responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
Strong project management experience with proven ability to deliver projects on schedule and within budget.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence behaviors and drive positive outcomes.
Proven success collaborating with and presenting to all levels of management.
Exceptional problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while meeting deadlines.
Strong resource planning, task scheduling, and organizational skills.
Highly resourceful with demonstrated ability to motivate and inspire others.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and related business software.

Preferred Competencies

Knowledge of construction, industrial, or field-based safety practices and regulations.
Experience developing and implementing safety programs and continuous improvement initiatives.
Familiarity with safety auditing, compliance management, and training program evaluation.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Ability to work in both office and field environments as required.
Occasional travel to project sites and company locations. Up to 25% travel required.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s and Master’s Degree preferred

Licensure/Certifications:
BCSP and PMP certification preferred

Experience:
7+ years’ experience in safety and/or project management. Construction industry experience preferred.

Driving Record:
Valid state-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

Preferred Qualifications:
Bilingual proficiency preferred.

CEI will never ask for any money or financial information from applicants during the hiring process. To learn more about "job scams" how to avoid them, click here.

CEI is a place where every single person can—and does—have an impact on the work we do and the communities we serve. Here, you can build your own story and grow to your full potential. You can collaborate and celebrate with amazing people. And you’ll go home every day knowing you helped contribute to important work that shapes people’s lives. Our commercial, data center and energy projects may be complex, but our approach is simple. We build great things and we do it with great people.

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Content & Business Products (CBP) Overview

The Content & Business Products (CBP) teams are fundamental to Netflix's mission to entertain the world. This organization is responsible for building the products and services that optimize and automate the entire content creation lifecycle, from initial concept and financial planning to global launch and promotion.

CBP is the engine behind "pitch to play," enabling our teams to create, manage, and distribute content at scale. In addition, we build and maintain critical enterprise products that ensure efficient operations across key internal departments, including Finance, Talent, and Customer Support.

The Team -Enterprise Engineering

By deploying world-class solutions across business functions and seamlessly integrating critical data streams, we empower our business units to scale efficiently, mitigate risks, and enhance decision-making to deliver a thrilling member experience. Our guiding principle is to champion a "Connected Enterprise"—where integrated data and workflows replace isolated point solutions.

We are seeking a dynamic Technical Program Manager with high agency and a strong sense of ownership to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams, as well as stakeholders across Finance, Talent, Legal, and Support teams. Partnering with fellow TPMs and senior leadership, you will execute, track, and deliver strategic initiatives that drive significant business value.

Responsibilities

Take full ownership of programs from inception to delivery, proactively driving progress with a high agency mindset.
Lead multiple cross-functional programs, in collaboration with product, engineering, design, and data science, that deliver technical solutions.
Drive engagement with cross-functional partners, work to decompose requirements into technical execution plans with measurable milestones, effectively optimize scope and schedule, manage cross-functional dependencies, and proactively identify and manage risks.
Craft clear, concise communication regarding progress toward goals, reporting status and insights to stakeholders and executive leadership.
Provide domain expertise to form technical strategies with engineering partners.
Scope and lead the execution of Generative AI/ML initiatives, working with engineering and data science partners to identify high-value use cases and productionize new AI platform capabilities.
Apply strong technical, organizational, and communication skills to devise sound technical approaches to abstract goals.
Identify the systems involved to build new solutions, align roadmaps, and weigh relative priorities.
Build strong relationships and rally the team with high emotional intelligence and exceptional listening skills.
Operate independently, challenge the status quo, and always play for the larger team.

Requirements

7+ years of technical program management experience
Proven experience driving large-scale software projects, managing the definition of technical strategies, and building long-term scalable solutions
Highly skilled, experienced, and enjoys orchestrating multiple programs with many moving parts and creating partnerships with cross-functional teams
Ability to identify solution gaps, debate technical approaches, and influence product vs. technology tradeoffs.
Deep understanding and point of view on the application of agentic capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate business impact and technical constraints tailored to the audience
As comfortable speaking technically as non-technically and able to bridge between the two.
Detail-oriented, can identify what’s missing in planning and execution of software development, testing, and launch.
Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

jobs.description:
Stimulus Technologies – Broadband Division

About Us

Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We are a turnkey technology company providing Managed IT Services, VoIP, Cybersecurity, and high-speed Wireless Internet and fiber through Stimulus Broadband.

Position Overview

The Technical Program Manager runs the network and systems programs for Stimulus Broadband outside the fiber build: integration of existing markets onto standard platforms, integration of acquired companies, and wireless network projects. The role owns schedule, cost, scope, risk and project gates for this portfolio and coordinates with the fiber deployment organization where they two depend on each other. The Technical Program Manager reports to the CTO.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the portfolio and master schedule for network and systems integration programs.
Market network integration program: migrate each market onto the target architecture and standard platforms, including cutover planning, subscriber migration and retiring legacy systems.
Run acquisition integration from diligence through cutover and decommissioning.
Manage wireless projects (sector augments, backhaul upgrades, site remediation) from scope through delivery, using contractors and field crews.
Track the NMS/OSS deployment roadmap by market and keep platform, network and operations sequenced.
Own program budgets and forecasts with finance.
Run project gates and coordinate release to production with Network Operations.
Maintain the project's intake queue and prioritization.
Hold vendors and contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
Own the risk register and drive escalations to closure.
Coordinate dependencies with the fiber build organization.
Report status to the CTO, CEO, and finance.
Travel to markets as business needs require.

Success Profile

Organized leader with can do attitude and able to work across a wide variety of functions
Holds vendors and internal teams to dates and scope.
Systems thinking and technical enough to challenge engineers and contractors.
Writes status an executive can act on quickly.

Required Skills & Qualifications

8+ years in technical program management on network, systems or infrastructure programs, preferably at an ISP, carrier or MSP.
Experience running migrations and cutovers on live networks with active subscribers.
Scheduling, critical path, program controls, forecasting, and change control.
Stage-gate governance and vendor and contractor management.
Working knowledge of fixed wireless, IP networking, NMS/OSS/BSS platforms, and fiber access.
ISP business knowledge: take rate, churn, cost per subscriber and payback.
Preferred: acquisition integration at an ISP or carrier; NMS/OSS platform deployments; wireless capital programs; hands-on engineering background.
Must reside in Nevada, California, Oregon, Missouri or New Mexico. Adjacent states may be considered for the right candidate.

Physical Requirements

Extended periods working at a computer.
Regular travel among markets for cutovers, project reviews and contractor oversight.
Occasional lifting of equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.
Site visits to data centers, tower sites and active project sites.

Requirements

Stimulus Technologies conducts pre-employment and random background checks, along with drug, alcohol, and cannabis testing. Candidates must pass all required screenings.
A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.

Alignment with Core Values

At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
See a Need – Fill a Need – Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and acts without waiting to be asked.
Elevate Others – Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
Celebrate Success – Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

Please Note:
To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

At CesiumAstro
, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Program Manager, Products
to our team. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming customer needs and solution architectures into well-defined, executable programs. Working within the Product Development & Assurance organization, the Senior Program Manager leads program formation from pre-contract solution development through proposal development, contract definitization, and transition to the execution team.

Partnering with Product, Technical Architects, Engineering, Business Development, Finance, Contracts, Supply Chain, and Program Management, the Senior Program Manager, Products translates the “what” of the solution into the “how” of execution. This includes establishing program scope and requirements, development plans, cost and schedule baselines, risks and opportunities, ground rules and assumptions, Make/Buy plans, and the overall program execution baseline.

This role also contributes to product strategy by identifying opportunities to leverage existing or in-development products, distinguishing reusable product capabilities from customer-specific development, and ensuring program decisions align with the company’s broader product roadmap.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Lead program formation. Own the development of the program execution approach from initial solution architecture through proposal, contract award, and transition into execution.
Establish executable program baselines. Develop integrated scope, requirements, cost, schedule, staffing, risk, and resource plans. Establish ground rules and assumptions and ensure the baseline is supported by the technical and business teams responsible for execution.
Translate architecture into execution. Partner with Technical Architects and Engineering to translate solution architectures into development plans, work packages, milestones, deliverables, and integrated program schedules.
Support product strategy and reuse. Evaluate opportunities to leverage existing and in-development products and identify where new reusable capabilities may be required versus customer-specific development. Provide program-level insight to Product leadership to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Drive proposal development. Provide the programmatic and execution content required for customer proposals, including Statements of Work, schedules, cost estimates, risks, assumptions, staffing plans, and execution approaches.
Support contract definitization. Partner with Contracts and business leadership during customer negotiations to ensure scope, requirements, deliverables, schedule, assumptions, and contractual commitments are consistent with the planned execution baseline.
Lead Make/Buy and supplier planning. Coordinate Make/Buy trades with Product, Engineering, and Supply Chain and establish supplier scope, requirements, cost, schedule, and assumptions required to support the program baseline.
Own program readiness and transition. Ensure awarded programs transition into execution with a clear SOW, requirements baseline, budget, integrated schedule, risk register, supplier commitments, ground rules and assumptions, and Program Management Plan.
Support early execution. Remain engaged with the execution Program Manager and Engineering team through transition and early program milestones, including SRR, to resolve gaps between the proposed, contracted, and executable baselines.
Provide program assurance. Identify and drive resolution of technical, cost, schedule, contractual, and execution risks before they become downstream program issues. Ensure commitments made during capture and proposal are understood, achievable, and appropriately baselined.
Integrate across functions. Serve as a central program integration point across Product, Engineering, Business Development, Finance, Contracts, Supply Chain, and execution teams to drive decisions and maintain alignment throughout program formation.

Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business administration, program management, operations management, supply chain management, or a related field with 12–15 years of related experience, Master's degree with 8–12 years of related experience, or PhD with 5–8 years of related experience in program management, project management, engineering, manufacturing, operations, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience establishing and managing scope, requirements, cost, schedule, risk, and execution baselines for complex technical programs.
Proficiency in supporting programs from pre-contract or proposal development through contract award and execution.
Extensive experience collaborating with engineering, finance, contracts, supply chain, and customer-facing organizations to develop and execute integrated program plans.

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.

Program Summary

KBR is seeking an Operations Program Manager to provide overall leadership, management, and operational oversight for a contract supporting multiple performance locations, with the primary duty station at Marine Corps Logistics Base (MCLB) Albany, Georgia. The Operations Program Manager serves as the senior contract representative responsible for ensuring successful contract execution, workforce management, operational performance, and customer satisfaction. This role oversees day-to-day operations across all contract locations, coordinates with government and contractor stakeholders, conducts program reviews and meetings, and ensures compliance with established policies, procedures, and contractual requirements. The position may require travel to supported sites to maintain effective program management and operational continuity.

Job Summary

The Operations Program Manager is responsible for daily management and supervision of contract personnel and operational activities. Key responsibilities include assigning work, managing employee performance, approving direct labor hours, coordinating work orders and tasking, tracking and reporting program metrics, and preparing presentations and visual reports for leadership and government customers. The role requires strong leadership, team-building, organizational, verbal, and written communication skills, as well as proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. The successful candidate must be capable of conducting meetings with contractor personnel, management teams, and government representatives while working independently to ensure efficient and professional contract performance.

Roles & Responsibilities

Serve as the primary liaison between contract personnel and Government representatives, ensuring effective communication, issue resolution, and customer satisfaction.
Direct and manage daily contract operations across multiple work centers and performance locations to ensure all contract requirements are met.
Oversee overall contract performance, workforce management, and operational execution across maintenance, logistics, warehousing, engineering, calibration, optics, supply, and production functions.
Supervise contractor personnel, assign tasks and work orders, approve direct labor hours, and manage workforce utilization.
Track, validate, and report direct labor hours, ensuring labor charges accurately align with attendance records and contract requirements.
Coordinate with finance personnel to resolve issues involving Job Order Numbers (JONs), cost codes, Cost Work Centers, NAVY ERP numbers, and McPalms data.
Manage program budgets, personnel, resources, schedules, and performance metrics to support operational objectives.
Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, staffing updates, metrics, and other contractual deliverables for Government leadership and the COR.
Conduct meetings with Government customers, contract personnel, and company leadership to review performance and operational status.
Oversee receiving, warehousing, distribution, inventory control, and maintenance-related operations.
Ensure efficient warehouse layout, space utilization, material flow, and operational effectiveness.
Implement and enforce operational policies, procedures, safety requirements, and best practices.
Maintain records of employee licenses, certifications, training, qualification requirements, and safety compliance.
Support employee onboarding activities, workforce movement, forklift/cart license processing, and administrative personnel actions.
Monitor contract staffing levels and coordinate recruiting, onboarding, and retention efforts as needed.
Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, contractual requirements, and applicable Government directives.
Utilize Microsoft Office and reporting tools to develop dashboards, metrics, presentations, and visual management products.
Provide leadership for large, multi-disciplinary teams supporting depot maintenance, production, warehousing, and industrial operations.
Travel to performance locations as required to support contract execution and operational oversight.
Work additional hours when necessary to meet mission requirements and customer needs.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of eight (8) years of program, operations, or project management experience supporting large-scale depot maintenance, industrial operations, production environments, logistics operations, or warehousing activities.
Demonstrated experience managing large teams of skilled trades personnel, technicians, logistics personnel, and support staff.
Strong leadership, organizational, multitasking, and team-building capabilities.
Experience managing direct labor reporting, workforce utilization, staffing, and operational performance metrics.
Working knowledge of production operations, warehouse management processes, supply chain activities, and maintenance operations.
Knowledge of OSHA regulations, workplace safety requirements, and industrial safety practices.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to prepare reports, presentations, briefings, and visual management products for customers and leadership.
Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Strong attention to detail with demonstrated proofreading, document review, and quality control capabilities.
Customer-focused mindset with the ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Possess and maintain a valid state driver's license.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Tier 3 (T3) Security Clearance and Common Access Card (CAC).
Ability to work onsite during normal working hours and additional hours as mission requirements dictate.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related discipline.
Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense, Marine Corps, Navy, Army, or other Federal Government contracts.
Experience managing multi-site operations within depot maintenance, industrial production, logistics, or warehousing environments.
Familiarity with NAVY ERP, McPalms, Job Order Numbers (JONs), Cost Work Centers, and Government labor reporting systems.
Experience overseeing large maintenance and sustainment programs with geographically dispersed workforces.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and workforce metrics.
Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Microsoft Visio, and Canva Professional.
Experience developing executive-level presentations, operational dashboards, and performance reports.
Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or warehouse optimization experience.
PMP (Project Management Professional), Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP), Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, or related professional certifications.
Experience managing Government deliverables, staffing reports, performance metrics, and COR communications.
Prior experience supporting depot-level maintenance, military logistics, warehousing, or industrial base operations.

Travel may be required to support manufacturing sites, suppliers, and customers.

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits including a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending accounts, disability coverage, paid time off, flexible work schedules, and professional training and development opportunities.

jobs.description:

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

We are seeking a Project Manager who possesses the ability to work with a small multi-disciplinary engineering team to assist leadership in the planning and execution of projects involving complex systems for a government customer. The successful candidate will utilize their communication skills, attention to detail, education, and experience to drive the success of these innovative projects.

Job Purpose
:

This position will support the engineering team in the design, development, testing and production phases of projects undertaken at PERATON Labs, the research and development arm of PERATON corporation.

Duties and Responsibilities Include, but not limited to:

Develop project plans with input from key stakeholders and ultimately seek formal approval from leadership.
