Track progress against approved project plan throughout the lifecycle of the project.
Communicate effectively with the engineering team to ascertain progress, understand work being performed and develop plans to mitigate risks.
Develop risk mitigation options when required to maintain cost and schedule, understand likelihood of occurrence and schedule impacts.
Convey to leadership, at reasonable interval, overall progress, risks, plans to mitigate risks, and potential schedule impacts.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services, dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We also offer IT, VoIP, and CyberSecurity services to a range of clients.

Position Overview

Own the project. Navigate the complexity. Deliver on the promise.
As a Project Manager at Stimulus Technologies, you lead grant-funded fiber deployment projects from design kickoff through construction and final network turnover, where execution isn’t just about timelines, but strict compliance, funding milestones, and public accountability. You are the single point of ownership for delivering projects that meet aggressive build schedules while satisfying state and federal grant requirements.
This is a high-ownership role where you’ll manage competing priorities across engineering partners, contractors, internal teams, and clients, while ensuring every decision aligns with budget, schedule, and reimbursement eligibility. You’ll proactively manage risk, enforce accountability, and keep projects moving in an environment where delays and missteps have real financial consequences. If you thrive in complex, high-stakes projects and want to lead work that directly impacts communities, this is your opportunity to take ownership and deliver at scale.

Essential Functions

Project Planning and Schedule Management
Develop and maintain the master project schedule encompassing design, permitting, construction, drop installation, testing, and network turnover milestones.
Coordinate schedule dependencies across the engineering firm (design and permitting), construction contractors (mainline build), and in-house crews (drop installation) to ensure alignment and prevent downstream delays.
Establish project milestones and critical path items; proactively identify schedule risks and develop mitigation plans.
Track and enforce compliance with grant-mandated buildout timelines, reporting deadlines, and program-specific milestone requirements.
Manage project scope and change control processes; evaluate and document the cost, schedule, and scope impact of all change requests before approval.
Facilitate project kickoff meetings and establish roles, responsibilities, and communication cadences with all internal and external stakeholders.

SOW, Contract, and Budget Management
Monitor the engineering firm’s performance against their SOW, deliverable schedules, and contract terms; document deviations and coordinate corrective actions with the Construction Manager and Director of Project Management.
Monitor construction contractor performance against contract terms, pay application accuracy, and change order justifications in coordination with the Construction Manager.
Develop and manage project budgets; track actual costs against forecasts and report variances to the Director of Project Management.
Review and approve invoices from the engineering firm, construction contractors, and permitting agencies for accuracy and contract alignment before processing.
Ensure all project expenditures are properly documented and categorized for grant reimbursement and compliance reporting.
Maintain organized contract files including SOWs, amendments, change orders, and correspondence for each project.

Stakeholder and Client Management
Serve as the primary point of contact for the client on project status, deliverables, and issue resolution.
Prepare and deliver regular project status reports to the client, Director of Project Management, and internal leadership including schedule performance, budget status, risks, and upcoming milestones.
Facilitate regular project status meetings with the client, engineering firm, construction contractors, and internal teams.
Manage client expectations and proactively communicate schedule or scope changes with proposed solutions.
Coordinate with the client on subscriber enrollment, service activation timelines, and drop installation priorities.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Coordinate with the Construction Manager on construction progress, contractor issues, and field resource needs.
Coordinate with the Permitting Manager on permit submittal schedules, approval status, and any permitting constraints affecting the construction schedule.
Coordinate with the Drop Installation Crew Manager on drop scheduling, production rates, and compliance with mandated installation timelines.
Work with the engineering firm to track design and permitting deliverable progress and ensure deliverables feed into the construction schedule on time.
Coordinate the construction-to-operations turnover process, ensuring all documentation, testing, and acceptance criteria are met before network handoff.
Identify resource conflicts or bottlenecks across projects and work with the Director of Project Management to prioritize and resolve.

Grant Compliance and Reporting
Ensure all project activities and documentation comply with state and federal grant program requirements.
Prepare and submit required grant reports, progress updates, and milestone certifications on schedule.
Maintain auditable project records including schedules, budgets, invoices, change orders, and deliverable logs for grant compliance purposes.
Track grant reimbursement submissions and coordinate with finance on draw schedules and funding status.
Stay current on grant program requirements and proactively communicate any compliance risks to the Director of Project Management.

Education and Experience

Required

High school diploma or GED; bachelor’s degree in project management, construction management, engineering, business, or related field preferred.
Minimum 5 years of project management experience in telecom, broadband, fiber optic, or utility construction.
Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, and contractor/vendor relationships.
Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction phases including design, permitting, mainline build, and drop installation.
Experience with SOW and contract compliance management for third-party engineering or construction firms.
Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client-facing reporting and stakeholder management.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
Valid driver’s license with the ability to travel to project sites as needed.

Preferred

PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
Experience with government-funded or grant-funded broadband deployment programs (BEAD, RDOF, ReConnect, CAF, or similar).
Familiarity with FTTH/FTTP deployment at scale.
Background in OSP engineering or construction management.
Experience with grant compliance reporting and reimbursement processes.

Alignment with Core Values

At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
See a Need – Fill a Need – Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and takes action without waiting to be asked.
Elevate Others – Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
Celebrate Success – Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

Management reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet business and organizational needs as necessary.

About The Role

Our Growth team finds, engages, and onboards the engineers, finance professionals, scientists, and other domain specialists whose judgment teaches AI systems how to reason in their field. We're looking for a Growth Program Manager to own the programs that make that happen.

This role is strategy and execution. You'll decide what to build and why, then build it. You'll take new initiatives from early and messy to scaled and repeatable, then move on to the next highest-impact problem. The programs you'll own are still being built, and you'll run them at a volume that surfaces problems nobody has seen yet. You'll use AI and automation to keep them from breaking as they scale.

We're looking for real ownership. You treat the program as your own, hold yourself accountable for the results, and don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

What You'll Do

Set the strategy for your programs: define goals, identify the biggest levers, and decide where to invest
Own execution end to end and be accountable for outcomes like pipeline, conversion, time-to-productive, and retention
Build and lead the teams that run your programs, including hiring leads who own their areas and setting clear expectations and performance standards
Build sustainable expert pipelines through targeted outreach, new channels, and creative approaches
Build AI workflows and automations that replace manual work in sourcing, outreach, screening, onboarding, and reporting, such as LLM-drafted outreach, lead enrichment, triage agents, QA checks, and self-updating dashboards
Stand up reporting that shows how each program is performing, where the gaps are, and what to do about them
Run a steady cadence of experiments on targeting, messaging, channels, process, and tooling, then turn what works into playbooks that people and agents can run
Partner closely with growth leads, operations, project teams, and vendors to align on priorities and keep work unblocked
Once a program is in steady state, hand it off cleanly and take on the next one

Who We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in program operations, growth, recruiting or workforce operations, strategy and operations, or a similar role
You've owned a program end to end, from setting the strategy to executing it. You were the person accountable when something broke, and the person who fixed it.
You move comfortably between big-picture thinking and details, and you're as happy building a plan as you are working through a spreadsheet
Experience building and managing teams, ideally distributed or contractor-based
Strong judgment about prioritization when there's more work than time, and you know when to escalate and when to resolve on your own
Data-driven: comfortable defining metrics, digging into funnels, and making decisions from imperfect data. You can run your own analysis in SQL or Python.
High agency and ownership. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down, and you thrive when given room to build something from nothing.
You've built things with AI. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, Make, Retool, or Apps Script as a core part of how you work, and you have at least one workflow, automation, or tool you built that people actually used. We want to hear about what you've built.
Clear, concise writer and communicator. Much of this job happens over Slack and email, and clarity compounds across hundreds of interactions.

Experience scaling a program through rapid growth
A background in recruiting at scale, talent sourcing, growth marketing, or community building
Experience in marketplace, gig, or external workforce businesses

Technical Credibility and Quality: Apply sound engineering judgment and sufficient technical depth in municipal water and wastewater planning, design, and construction to challenge assumptions, integrate multidisciplinary input, and guide defensible project decisions. Understand the basis of design, key technical risks, permitting and constructability considerations, and quality requirements. Prepare and review timely client billings, support collection of outstanding invoices, and review subcontractor and vendor invoices. Recognize out-of-scope work early and secure appropriate authorization before proceeding.
Scope, Schedule, Risk, and Change Management: Continuously evaluate project status, critical path, dependencies, risks, and commitments. Use project performance information to anticipate issues, implement recovery actions, and escalate material concerns. Apply disciplined change management protocols, document decisions, align internal and external stakeholders, and maintain clear accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and deliverables. Ensure safety plans and audit corrective actions are addressed.
Resource Management and Team Development: Develop and maintain a realistic resource plan, secure the right internal and external expertise, and coordinate subcontractor and vendor support in accordance with procurement requirements. Clearly communicate assignments, deadlines, quality expectations, and decision authority. Provide timely direction, coaching, recognition, and constructive feedback, and partner with supervisors to support staff development and address performance concerns.
Business Development and Sales Collaboration: Partner with sales and technical leaders to identify and shape opportunities, assess delivery risks, and develop credible scopes, staffing plans, schedules, and fees. Support interviews, proposals, and client presentations with a clear understanding of client drivers and project outcomes. Create opportunities for additional services and repeat business through strong execution, technical credibility, and trusted client relationships.
Professional and Industry Engagement: Represent CDM Smith through participation in relevant professional societies and industry activities, strengthening technical networks, market awareness, and client relationships.

Description du poste

Métier

METIERS - Projets / Études / MOA/ Chef de produit

Intitulé du poste

Business Analyst Monétique - Moyens de Paiement H/F

Contrat

CDI

35 à 45K€

Votre mission

Nous recherchons notre futur Business Analyst Monétique, pour rejoindre le service MOA Emission Monétique au sein du Crédit Mutuel Arkéa.

Cette équipe composée de 11 collaborateurs regroupe 3 squads produits et 2 squads projets :

Squad Emission Cartapuce : expertise carte, souscription et fabrication de la carte physique, gestion de son cycle de vie et des services adossés ;
Squad Emission Paymobil : en charge des services de paiements mobiles et des solutions de tokenisation adossées à la carte physique ;
Squad Tautem : gestion des authentifications et des autorisations des transactions réalisées à partir d’une carte physique, d’un mobile ou d’une carte virtuelle ;
Team projet Virtualis : refonte du produit Virtualis ;
Squad projet ClickToPay : nouveau Wallet de paiement en ligne simplifié en un clic.

Vous intégrerez la team projet ClickToPay en tant que Business Analyst.
Vous serez amené à travailler sur le développement de ce nouveau produit. La team projet est constituée mais il nous faut la renforcer en cours de projet et à plus long terme pour basculer en mode produit.

Ce projet doit implémenter une nouvelle solution de paiement en ligne proposée depuis l’application bancaire. Celle-ci, suite à l’accord du client, déclenche un enrôlement à partir du device et des données client. A la suite de cet enrôlement, le client va pouvoir payer ses achats en ligne en un clic. Cette solution de paiement fait appel à la tokenisation.

Vos missions :

Contribuer aux analyses fonctionnelles requises par les évolutions du produit et les exigences réglementaires
Piloter notre éditeur pour garder une solution conforme et robuste
Valider les évolutions et garantir la qualité de service sur le périmètre en charge
Suivre la méthode de gestion de Projet
Valider le bon fonctionnement en production
Rédiger les procédures et documentations relatives aux évolutions mises en œuvre
Contribuer activement à l'endiguement de la fraude et à l’amélioration continue.

Dans le détail, vos activités principales seront les suivantes :

Participer à la phase d'expression de besoin et de cadrage
Être force de proposition sur les solutions à mettre en œuvre en collaboration avec la MOE
Rédiger des spécifications fonctionnelles
Définir la stratégie de tests, valider les cas de test et garantir la qualité du livrable
Suivre les incidents, participer à l’analyse et valider la mise en œuvre des correctifs en collaboration avec les autres membres de la Squad
Participer aux différentes cérémonies qui rythment la vie de l’équipe (daily, planning,etc) et, plus globalement, à l'animation de l’équipe.

Et si c'était vous ?

De formation supérieure scientifique (Bac+5) vous disposez de bonnes connaissances IT, acquises idéalement depuis plus de 3 ans.

Vos compétences analytiques
sont reconnues.

Vous avez des connaissances confirmées en API (3 ans et plus dans le domaine).

La maîtrise de la méthodologie de gestion de projet constituerait un plus.

Vous vous reconnaissez également dans ces qualités :

Bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse
Aptitude et goût pour le travail en équipe et la gestion de projets informatiques
Appétence forte pour le fonctionnel, pour l’analyse métier (et idéalement, pour les moyens de paiement !)
Capacité à travailler en collaboration avec les interlocuteurs métiers sur des projets complexes
Intérêt pour le partage d'expérience, combiné à un excellent relationnel (interactions avec des parties prenantes variées)
Sérénité, autonomie et rigueur (les activités peuvent être soutenues et les attentes des partenaires sont fortes).

Nous rejoindre, c’est :

intégrer une équipe mixte (experts et juniors) où l’entraide est la valeur clé ;
bénéficier de connexions fortes entre les équipes produits qui offrent une vue transverse du périmètre monétique ;
s’épanouir dans un périmètre fonctionnel passionnant et très évolutif ;
la possibilité d’évoluer, à terme, vers un rôle de Product Owner.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Au sein du Pôle ARKEA Système d’Information, la Direction des Flux et Paiements (DFP) regroupe l’ensemble des métiers MOA et MOE des moyens de paiements.

La DFP est composée de 5 départements (Développement Relation de Place Moyens de Paiements, Performance et Expertise Paiements, Flux, Monétique, Opérations Paiements).

Le Département Monétique regroupe quant à lui 4 services :

MOA Emission Monétique
MOE Emission Monétique
MOA Acquisition et Compensation Monétique
MOE Acquisition et Compensation Monétique

Les moyens de paiement adossés à la carte physique se multiplient et le département travaille sur le développement d’un nouveau produit : ClicktoPay.

Le Relecq-Kerhuon près de Brest

jobs.title: Cyber Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

This Senior Analyst position supports the Department of War (aka DoD) Cyber Crime Center (DC3) and participates as a team member serving as a Cyber Intelligence Analyst that applies intelligence analysis skills to monitor, assess, and report on cyberspace operations, capabilities, vulnerabilities, and personalities that could pose a threat to Department of War (DoD) critical assets, the DoW Information Network (DoWIN), Defense Industrial Base (DIB) networks and supports US Intelligence Community and Interagency cyber-focused portfolios. Conducts reviews, identifies gaps, recommends solutions, and evaluates large datasets from a myriad of sources. Develops reports, briefing artifacts, and delivers briefings to senior-level officials and represent analytical teams in Interagency and technical forums.

You will research and analyze intelligence on Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) groups, assess and attribute malware, and cyber warfare tactics, assess impacts on DoW networks, develop threat profiles, maintain analytic procedures, collect data, and produce high-quality reports and presentations for senior US government officials.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

Threat Monitoring and Assessment: Monitor and analyze cyberspace operations and vulnerabilities, providing detailed assessments and reports on potential threats to DoD assets.
Data Evaluation and Recommendations: Conduct thorough reviews, identify gaps, make recommendations, and evaluate large datasets from various sources to enhance cybersecurity measures.
Report and Briefing Development: Develop a variety of intelligence and operational reports, as well as briefing materials through established reporting systems such as Grapevine/RAD (Report, Authoring & Dissemination), and CHROME. Deliver presentations to senior officials and represent analytic teams in interagency and technical forums.
Mentoring: Serve as a mentor to mid-level analysts and junior staff, providing guidance and expertise on best practices and methodologies.
All-Source Intelligence Research: Research and evaluate technical and all-source intelligence, with an emphasis on Advanced Persistent Threat Groups, malware analysis, network operations, and cyber warfare tactics.
Cyber Threat Analysis: Analyze cyber threat data from multiple sources to determine impacts on current operations and assess adversary capabilities and intent.
Profile Development: Prepare detailed assessments and cyber threat profiles of current events based on sophisticated collection, research, and analysis of classified and Open-Source information; develop, maintain and update organizational Rosetta for threat actor activity.
Procedure Development: Develop and maintain analytic procedures to adapt to changing requirements and ensure optimal operations. Proficient in the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance intelligence research and enrich reporting with an emphasis on automation.
Data Collection: Collect data using a combination of standard intelligence methods and business processes.
High-Quality Deliverables: Produce high-quality papers, presentations, recommendations, and findings for senior US government intelligence and network operations officials.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with Ph.D. A degree in one of the following fields is highly desired: Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or Data Science. However, four years of experience can be accepted in lieu of a Bachelor's degree.
Active TS/SCI with Poly eligibility.
Requires experience providing integrated cyber, financial, virtual asset/virtual currency, and business analysis with advanced analytics and data science to support national security, criminal, cyber, and counterintelligence investigations and operations.
Proficient using analytic tools common to the Intelligence Community and Cyber Threat Intelligence research and production (e.g., Augury, Google Threat Intelligence, GrayNoise, Censys, Domain Tools, Shodan).
Experience using Open Source intelligence tools such as DarkBlue and other managed attribution systems.
Experience with MITRE ATT&CK framework for advanced threat analysis.
Demonstrated experience in gathering, analyzing, correlating, or evaluating information from various resources, including law enforcement databases, and supporting Law Enforcement/Counterintelligence (LE/CI) Operations and/or Cyberspace Operations.
Knowledge of network and application protocols, cyber vulnerabilities and exploitation techniques, and cyber threat/adversary methodologies (TTPs).
Proficient in building extended cybersecurity analytics.
Proven experience briefing Senior Executive Service (SES) and General Officer/Flag Officer (GO/FO) leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

Joint Cyber Analysis Course (JCAC) graduate, or advanced degree in Cybersecurity.
Experience in intelligence-driven defense and/or Cyber-Kill Chain methodologies.
Desirable certifications: IAM Level II & III, Security+, CEH, CySA+, GCTI, or other SANS cybersecurity, incident response, and Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) certifications.
Possess understanding of Cloud Security Architecture and related aspects of cybersecurity operations/analysis, including incident response and management, forensic media analysis, malware analysis/reverse-engineering, and cyber threat intelligence analysis.
Operational Technology (OT) experience.
Experience with virtual currency transaction tracing utilizing blockchain analytical tools/explorers offered through Chainalysis, TRM labs, and other digital asset analysis tool suite providers.

Desired experience:

Foreign language experience in any of the following languages: Chinese Mandarin; Korean; Russian; Persian Farsi; Arabic. Native-level experience is a plus.
Experience with Title 18 and Title 32 authorities.

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

At Legion Systems, your expertise contributes to work that matters. Join a team focused on solving complex challenges, supporting our customers, and advancing national security. We look forward to learning how your experience and talents can contribute to our mission.

The Job Description outlined below provide a general overview of the position and do not represent every task that may be assigned. Legion Systems employees are expected to contribute to evolving priorities and accept other assignments that support client requirements, organizational objectives, and our commitment to teamwork and flexibility.

Description

The Contractor shall provide Intelligence Analysts responsible for researching, developing, and presenting intelligence products at the operational level for senior leaders, commanders, and staff. ,

Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to concurrently manage multiple high-priority projects end to end
Strong work ethic and demonstrated ability to work both independently and with peers
Skilled at exercising high-level judgment and navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to describe technical implementations or analyses to a non-technical audience in an effective manner

2+ years of experience applying SQL in investigations work, including independently querying large datasets, joining multiple data sources, and identifying trends, patterns, and anomalous behavior

jobs.description:
Designalytics is seeking motivated and analytically minded early-career professionals for multiple openings as Research Analysts. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience (including relevant internships) to apply and grow their skills in quantitative research, consumer behavior, and data-driven decision-making.

**Please note, this full time opportunty has a start date of January 4th, 2027** (New Grads only apply)

What You'll Do:

Execute quantitative research studies to evaluate package design performance using survey data, retail scanner data, and automated analytics.
Program and quality-assure surveys and data collection tools, ensuring accuracy, validity, and respondent logic.
Monitor fielding and data collection, making real-time decisions to support successful study completion.
Analyze quantitative consumer data to uncover patterns in shopper perception and behavior.
Interpret scanner (sales) data (e.g., from IRI or Nielsen) to determine representative SKUs and identify market trends.
Curate and publish data-rich reports that turn complex findings into digestible, actionable insights for clients.
Develop category recommendations that integrate quantitative insights from shopper, manufacturer, and retailer perspectives.
Support shelving strategy and navigation insights using behavioral and numeric data.
Collaborate with product and ops teams to enhance automation and efficiency in data processing and reporting.

Stretch Opportunities (as you grow):

Own end-to-end quantitative research projects, from survey design to final report delivery.
Conduct meta-analyses across categories to identify industry trends and insights.
Publish whitepapers, blog posts, or present at industry conferences to share your findings.
Contribute to cross-functional initiatives, such as improving field operations, scaling automation, or supporting global research models.

What We're Looking For:

0–2 years of experience (including internships) in quantitative research, market research, or data analytics.
Strong foundation in quantitative methods, including survey research, data cleaning, and statistical interpretation.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, synthesize, and interpret numeric data from multiple sources.
Excellent critical thinking skills and the ability to question assumptions and validate findings.
Comfortable switching between analytical detail and strategic thinking.
Effective communication skills—able to explain quantitative findings clearly and persuasively.
Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with survey platforms (e.g., Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey), SQL, R, or Python is a plus.
BS/BA in Statistics, Marketing, Psychology, Economics, Business, or related field.

Remote

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance) –
jobs.description:
Company

Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance) works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO/CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $110,000 - $130,000

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Perform security assessments and risk analyses of systems, applications, AI solutions, and business processes.
Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvements of cybersecurity and AI governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate with IT, software development, and business teams to implement security best practices and controls (security-by-design principles and secure technology solutions)
Participate in the review, risk assessment, and governance oversight of internally developed AI solutions, machine learning models, and employee-driven AI initiatives.
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, applications, and services for cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data protection, and operational risks.
Identify, assess, and monitor risks associated with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning platforms, prompt injection attacks, data leakage, insecure APIs, and AI supply chain vulnerabilities.
Assist with the development and administration of the organization's AI governance and Shadow AI oversight programs.
Support secure development practices for internally developed applications and AI-enabled solutions, and emerging technology initiatives.
Participate in security awareness and AI awareness training initiatives for employees.
Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.
Maintain inventories of approved AI solutions, AI vendors, and AI-related business initiatives.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, risk assessments, and documentation related to cybersecurity operations, AI governance, compliance and enterprise risk management activities.

Qualifications

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Minimum of 2–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, GRC, application security, vendor risk, privacy, IT audit, compliance, technology governance, or a related discipline.
Experience performing technology, security, vendor, application, privacy, or operational risk assessments.
Experience developing, interpreting, implementing, or supporting technology policies, standards, procedures, or governance processes.
Experience evaluating new technologies, applications, vendors, or services from a risk and security perspective.
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document risks and develop recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.
Demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence, generative AI, responsible AI adoption, and emerging technology risk.
Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled business applications.

Proficient In The Following Areas

Familiarity with AI governance principles and emerging AI risk management frameworks.
AI governance concepts and risks associated with generative AI technologies.
Data protection, data classification, privacy, and appropriate data use.
Knowledge of application security concepts, API security, and secure software development practices.
Understanding of risks associated with generative AI platforms, LLMs, prompt injection, data privacy, and AI model security.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to independently research emerging technologies and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Ability to write and present formal documentation, risk assessments, and executive-level reports.
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and security best practices.
Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) tools and security monitoring platforms is a PLUS.
Experience supporting software development, DevSecOps, or application security initiatives is a PLUS.

Preferred Certifications

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
CompTIA Security+
GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
Relevant AI Security, Cloud Security, Application Security, or Governance certifications are highly desirable.

Physical Requirements

Remains in a sitting/stationary position continually or almost continually during the work day
Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually; frequently viewing a computer screen
Rarely lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling objects and/or equipment that weighs up to 50 pounds

NOTE:
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications.

To apply for the Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)

position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .

jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

The Sustainability & Resiliency Data Analyst II will support multidisciplinary S&R technical teams through data management, integration, analysis, visualization, and project delivery. Based within the Resources Business Group, this position will work across HDR business groups and market sectors to help teams organize complex information and produce reliable, decision-ready data products.

A primary focus of the role is helping technical teams transform data from multiple sources into clear, accurate, and actionable information. The Analyst will support data collection, ingestion, validation, documentation, integration, analysis, dashboards, and visual communication while improving data quality standards and procedures.

The position will also evaluate and apply analytical, automation, and emerging digital tools to improve data workflows, strengthen consistency, and help project teams understand and communicate complex information more effectively.

Key Responsibilities -
In the role of Sustainability & Resiliency Data Analyst II, we'll count on you to:

Data Management, Integration & Visualization

Collect, organize, clean, and maintain data from multiple internal and external sources.
Import, transform, and integrate structured and unstructured data for use by technical teams.
Develop dashboards, maps, graphics, and other visual tools that translate complex data into clear, usable information.
Support data validation, metadata, lineage, version control, and documentation to improve reliability and traceability.

Technical Team & Project Delivery Support

Support multidisciplinary technical projects across HDR business groups and market sectors.
Work with subject matter experts to define data requirements, resolve data gaps, and connect information across disciplines and systems.
Prepare technical memoranda, reports, presentations, client materials, and data-driven visual deliverables.
Help technical teams interpret data, identify trends and anomalies, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly.

Data Quality, Standards & Emerging Tools

Develop, document, and improve data quality standards, procedures, checks, and reusable workflows.
Perform data profiling and quality reviews to identify inconsistencies, duplication, missing information, and other issues.
Evaluate new datasets, analytical methods, and visualization approaches that can strengthen project delivery.
Explore appropriate uses of AI, automation, and emerging digital tools for research, data processing, analysis, and visualization.
Develop reusable templates, dashboards, data dictionaries, and guidance, and share lessons learned with project teams.

Cross-Business-Group Support -

The Analyst will collaborate with professionals across business groups, geographies, and technical disciplines to strengthen data practices and support consistent, high-quality project delivery.
The position will connect data, digital capabilities, and technical expertise across HDR. The Analyst is not expected to be a subject matter expert in every discipline but should be curious, adaptable, and skilled at learning new datasets, systems, terminology, and workflows.

Capabilities & Skills -
The following capabilities will be used and further developed in this position:

Data management and data strategy
Data quality assessment, validation, and governance
Data ingestion, transformation, and integration
Data profiling, documentation, metadata, and lineage
Dashboard development and data visualization
Quantitative and qualitative analysis and interpretation
AI-assisted research, automation, and analysis
Technology and digital tool evaluation
Technical writing, synthesis, and visual communication
Multidisciplinary project collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a related field

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related field
A minimum of 3 years of related work experience
Self Starter
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Job Description

Security Analyst

$60/hr-$65/hr

Daily Duties / Responsibilities

Continuously review and correlate security event data across SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and

threat intelligence sources to identify complex attack patterns, emerging threats, and security incidents.

Perform deep-dive analysis of suspicious activity, validate incidents, determine root cause and impact, and escalate critical incidents with detailed context to Tier 3 as required.
Create detailed incident reports, timelines, and post-incident summaries; contribute

to lessons-learned documentation and recommendations for remediation and preventative measures.

Investigate user-reported phishing, malware infections, and potential policy

violations; advise users and internal/external teams on containment and recovery actions.

Recommend updates to SOC playbooks and workflows based on real-world INVESTIGATIONS, fine-tune detection rules. Alert thresholds, and correlation logic to reduce false positives and improve threat coverage.
Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure monitoring tools are properly configured and tuned. Integrate new threat intelligence feeds into workflows and proactively hunt for threats using up-to date tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
Serve as a customer-facing SME, “selling” the value of DIS services by demonstrating capabilities and resolving issues.
Document processes, runbooks, and troubleshooting steps related to SOC operations.
Coordinate with engineering, SOC, and agency staff as needed to meet goals.
Other duties as needed.

2+ Years of Experience with Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
2+ Years of Experience with MITRE ATT&CK framework.
2+ Years of Experience with dashboard creation and reporting.

Preferred Skills (rank In Order Of Importance)

Experience with the Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM/XDR platform.
Knowledge of Linux, network administration and network design.
Experience in administration of firewalls, VPN technology, Active Directory, Intrusion Detection/Prevention systems.
Candidate is local to Columbia, SC or surrounding city in South Carolina

Required Education/Certifications

Associate’s degree in an information technology or information security related field
Four years of relevant work experience may be substituted in lieu of education
Two years of experience in supporting large soc operations

ISS STOXX is hiring! We are seeking Junior Research Analyst to join the ISS STOXX Research Team. The main responsibility is to analyze proxy statements to complete proxy analyses for shareholders' meetings of publicly traded companies covered by ISS STOXX' Research team.

This position will be based in Ayala North Exchange Makati and will report to the lead of Research handling a specific market.

Responsibilities

Gain understanding of investment and shareholder issues gathered through fundamental research.
Distill financial and corporate governance information to write research reports and issue proxy vote recommendations based on ISS' policy guidelines.
Maintain advanced understanding of compensation, board, and shareholder rights issues.
Answer internal or external issuer queries on research reports and be able to discuss policy issues.
Actively participate in various working committees and/or special projects

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or equivalent
Knowledge in investment analysis and/or financial research, or other business-related areas
Basic analytical ability and financial understanding of investment issues
Understanding of corporate governance issues, corporate transactions, and capital markets
Strong oral and written communication skills
Strong attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
Ability to work within a team-oriented environment.
Average knowledge of Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel
Amenable to working on extended hours (overtime, holiday & weekend work) as needed by the business.
Willing to work for a full-time contractual/temporary employment that will last for 5 to 6 months.

WORK LOCATION & SCHEDULE

Amenable working on a dayshift schedule. Our office is located at 12/F Ayala North Exchange Tower 2, Makati.

#ENTRYLEVEL

#RESEARCH

What You Can Expect From Us

Our people are the moving force behind our work. We are committed to building a culture that values diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences. If you have the skills, passion, and drive to help us bring clarity and transparency to capital markets, we want to work with you.

Together, we can grow your career in an environment that fuels creativity, drives innovation, and has real impact.

About ISS STOXX

ISS STOXX delivers world-class research, data, and technology solutions that empower capital market participants to pursue their visions with confidence. Our expertise spans indices, corporate governance, sustainability, cyber risk, and fund intelligence, giving clients the tools they need to uncover opportunities, manage risks, and navigate evolving regulations. We are made up of 4,000 professionals operating across 20 countries and serving approximately 5,000 clients, including many of the world’s leading institutional investors. Our scale and reach give us deep market knowledge, while our innovative methodologies allow us to offer our clients tailored insights that drive impact and success.

ISS STOXX Governance
delivers comprehensive corporate governance research, analytics, and investor voting solutions supported by a global, high‑quality data set spanning diverse markets and topics. Our offerings equip investors with the depth and scale needed to meet evolving stewardship priorities. We provide flexible voting policy options, including fully customizable reports, backed by experienced research teams located worldwide, ensuring clients benefit from both global insight and local market expertise.

jobs.title: Security Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Required Skills & Experience

• 2+ years of experience conducting secure design reviews and cybersecurity risk assessments across cloud, on-premise, and SaaS environments
• Strong knowledge of information security frameworks and standards, including CSA CCM, ISO, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, and/or NIST 800-53
• Previous cybersecurity experience in a consulting or advisory capacity, working with Technology, Project, Risk, and Business teams
• Experience assessing security risks and providing security recommendations based on application security testing, including Secure Code Review, DAST, and SAST
• Applied experience conducting threat modeling for new applications, services, or technology solutions
• Working knowledge of AI systems and security controls applicable to AI solutions and technologies
• Strong ability to identify, document, articulate, and communicate cybersecurity risks and recommendations to both technical teams and business leadership
• Experience collaborating with Risk and Privacy teams to ensure security assessments align with compliance and regulatory requirements
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

• CISSP, CRISC, ISSAP, CISM, CISA, and/or CCSP certification
• Experience performing security assessments within a large enterprise or professional services environment
• Experience working with formal security assessment and risk management documentation, including Security Assessment Reports (SAR) and Quality Risk Management (QRM)
• Familiarity with security approval and governance processes for enterprise technology initiatives

Job Summary

Insight Global is seeking a Security Risk Analyst to join a leading professional services organization supporting its cybersecurity and security risk function.

The Security Risk Analyst will partner with Business, Risk, Privacy, and Technology teams to conduct cybersecurity risk assessments and ensure security is incorporated into the design of new business applications, services, and projects. This individual will assess potential threats and risks, review security requirements, and provide practical recommendations that align with organizational security standards, regulatory requirements, and business needs.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with security risk assessments, secure design, threat modeling, security frameworks, and application security testing, combined with the communication skills needed to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with Business and Risk teams to gather information on new projects, applications, services, and technology requirements
• Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments and secure design reviews for cloud, on-premise, and SaaS environments
• Review business applications and services to ensure alignment with applicable security standards, policies, and compliance requirements
• Identify cybersecurity risks and provide practical security recommendations and remediation guidance
• Review application security testing outcomes, including Secure Code Review, DAST, and SAST, and recommend appropriate security actions
• Conduct threat-modeling exercises for new applications, services, and technology solutions
• Coordinate with Privacy, Risk, Business, and Technology teams to ensure security requirements and assessments are properly documented
• Document and track identified risks and recommendations through Security Assessment Reports (SAR) and Quality Risk Management (QRM) processes
• Obtain required NITSO approvals as applicable
• Maintain security tracking for critical business projects and initiatives
• Clearly communicate identified risks, recommendations, and security requirements to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership

AI: Artificial intelligence tools are used to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position.

Vacancy: This posting is for a currently vacant role, and the successful candidate will be hired into an existing open position.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The Data Analyst (Finance)
serves as the primary analytical and data-process partner between the data team and the Finance team, ensuring that financial data from the enterprise data warehouse (EDW) is accurate, complete, timely, and usable for accounting, reporting, and ad hoc analysis. This full-time role oversees the existing daily finance ETL accounting process, reconciles EDW outputs against current processes, investigates variances, and establishes repeatable validation frameworks across premium, commissions, taxes, fees, payments, and other policy transaction data.

Key Responsibilities

Assume day-to-day responsibility for running, monitoring, and troubleshooting the daily finance ETL accounting process to produce policy transactions and monetary amounts across premiums, taxes, and fees.
Compare and reconcile financial data produced by the EDW with current finance ETL outputs across policy, transaction, coverage, and other business grains.
Investigate variances and identify root causes, including missing or duplicated transactions, timing differences, incorrect signs, mapping and join errors, effective date discrepancies, transformation logic flaws, or source-data defects.
Write, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries to validate, transform, and reconcile policy, premium, commission, payment, tax, and fee data, creating reusable queries and process components.
Establish, document, and maintain automated validation rules, reconciliation checks, reasonableness tests, and exception reporting for EDW financial data.
Provide the Finance team with accurate recurring data, reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules for accounting, financial reporting, period-end close, and operational needs.
Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to define financial metrics, transaction treatments, data definitions, accounting assumptions, and acceptance criteria for EDW deliverables.
Partner with data engineers to trace source-to-target logic, recommend field-level changes, validate defect fixes, and maintain reliable production processes.
Build and apply deep knowledge of the EDW data model, including policy lifecycles, transaction data, source systems, data layers, and reporting relationships.
Assist in defining how paid data is sourced, ingested, modeled, validated, and published in the EDW, including historical depth, timing, grain, and financial attributes.
Support portfolio and program health check reporting through data preparation, KPI tracking, and process improvements.
Conduct ad hoc financial analyses, quantifying business impacts, analyzing trends, and translating findings into clear takeaways.
Maintain comprehensive process flows, SQL documentation, data dictionaries, reconciliation procedures, and issue logs.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of experience in finance data analysis, financial reporting, accounting analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical roles.
2+ years of experience working with commercial or specialty insurance transaction data, including policy, premium, commission, paid, tax, or fee data.
Working knowledge of insurance concepts, including premium and commission transactions, taxes, fees, and reconciliations.
Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, aggregations, financial reconciliations, data validation, and the development of reusable processes.
Demonstrated experience comparing data across systems or ETL processes and diagnosing the root causes of discrepancies.
Proven experience building and maintaining recurring reports, validation checks, or financial data controls using SQL, Excel, BI tools, or similar platforms.
Strong critical thinking, attention to detail, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to convey technical and financial concepts to diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, data analytics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience supporting financial processes, planning, management reporting, or process automation.
Experience with enterprise data warehouses, relational or dimensional data models, or data pipeline development.
Familiarity with Databricks, PySpark, Python, Azure, or similar data engineering and development tools.
Experience with Power BI or other BI tools, as well as ERP, general ledger, premium accounting, policy administration, or billing systems.
Ability to travel up to 5% of the year.

Working Conditions

Requires working in a quiet environment with regular sitting at a computer for extended periods.
Regular use of hands and fingers, along with frequent talking and hearing.
Occasional walking, standing, and lifting of items up to 10 lbs.
Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Position Overview

This Clinical Data Analyst / Informatics Consultant will work in Clinical and Translational Science Institute (CTSI) supporting Biomedical Informatics.

The University of Minnesota- Clinical Translational Science Institute (UMN-CTSI) is committed to an excellent employee experience, offering a flexible work environment that meets the needs of students, staff, faculty, and the communities we serve. Flexible work arrangements may include flexibility in schedule and/or work location. All UMN employees are expected to follow applicable public health and safety procedures. This position is remote with an option to work on campus.

Job Responsibilities

Communication (10%):
Work with investigators, research personnel and other stakeholders to promote informatics services.

Promote available CTSI Informatics services to investigators and research staff.
Coordinate user testing/usability evaluation of offered services and capture needs for potential future enhancements.
Ensure service delivery progress, delays and/or issues are regularly communicated with team management.

Informatics Consultation (30%): Document project requirements, implementation plan, change management, execution and delivery.

Create consultation reports that capture project requirements, the implementation plan, as well as the execution and delivery of the project or product.
Ensure that all informatics activities meet various compliance standards, IRB, data security, and contractual obligations of the University of Minnesota.
Follow standard operating procedures and adhere to team policies and best practices.
Strive for a high-quality client experience and excellent user satisfaction.
Discuss and provide feedback related to opportunities for enhancement with team management.
Follow-up with investigators and staff to ensure delivered services meet users’ expectations.
Train users on data access procedures, analysis tools, and informatics infrastructure.

Technical (60%): Query, extract, integrate, format, deliver and analyze data as per project needs.

Run feasibility analysis to ensure project requirements can be processed through available informatics services. Assess availability of raw data and provide information about data quality to investigators and research personnel.
Write code to query raw data and perform data transformation using tools such as SMMS, SQL Developer, SAS and/or R.
Explore, investigate and propose alternative ways of identifying patient cohorts when data elements are not clear or are unavailable.
Work closely with other team members to review execution plans and validate results.
Continually seek to improve knowledge of new clinical data sources.

Qualifications

All required qualifications must be documented on application materials.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS and 6+ years of relevant analytical or quantitative work experience, or an advanced degree with a minimum of 4 years of experience in areas directly related to the position. Experience must include a minimum of three years of experience querying, extracting, formatting, and analyzing healthcare data such as inpatient/outpatient clinical records, labs, medications, provider data, and/or claims.
Experience working with messy real-world data.
Experience working independently in a rapidly changing scientific environment.
Proficiency with query development and report writing.
Demonstrated experience with T-SQL, PL/SQL, SAS and/or R programming languages.
Knowledge of healthcare data management concepts and regulatory/compliance policies (HIPAA, IRB, etc.).
Superior human relation skills, such as, the ability to use positive language communications to serve and influence our customers and stakeholders.
Ability to participate in occasional domestic travel to attend conferences or training workshops.
Ability to support multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize assignments and work under limited supervision.
Comfortable providing rapid and timely response to urgent requests.
Comfortable following directions/instructions from supervisors and senior staff.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of clinical data and healthcare code sets and ontologies (ICD9/ICD10, CPT, NDC/RXNorm, LOINC, etc.).
Strong customer-facing experience, preferably with physicians, investigators, faculty/academic and research support staff.
Experience with data visualization tools (Qlikview, Tableau).
Research experience is a plus.
Exposure to statistical modelling and/or advanced analytics using R or Python.

The University of Minnesota Clinical and Translational Science Institute (CTSI) mission is to accelerate and improve clinical and translational science research, education and improve health. CTSI provides consultation, training, support, and services to researchers and research teams across the translational continuum. jobs.title: Growth Program Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

Our Growth team finds, engages, and onboards the engineers, finance professionals, scientists, and other domain specialists whose judgment teaches AI systems how to reason in their field. We're looking for a Growth Program Manager to own the programs that make that happen.

This role is strategy and execution. You'll decide what to build and why, then build it. You'll take new initiatives from early and messy to scaled and repeatable, then move on to the next highest-impact problem. The programs you'll own are still being built, and you'll run them at a volume that surfaces problems nobody has seen yet. You'll use AI and automation to keep them from breaking as they scale.

We're looking for real ownership. You treat the program as your own, hold yourself accountable for the results, and don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

What You'll Do

Set the strategy for your programs: define goals, identify the biggest levers, and decide where to invest
Own execution end to end and be accountable for outcomes like pipeline, conversion, time-to-productive, and retention
Build and lead the teams that run your programs, including hiring leads who own their areas and setting clear expectations and performance standards
Build sustainable expert pipelines through targeted outreach, new channels, and creative approaches
Build AI workflows and automations that replace manual work in sourcing, outreach, screening, onboarding, and reporting, such as LLM-drafted outreach, lead enrichment, triage agents, QA checks, and self-updating dashboards
Stand up reporting that shows how each program is performing, where the gaps are, and what to do about them
Run a steady cadence of experiments on targeting, messaging, channels, process, and tooling, then turn what works into playbooks that people and agents can run
Partner closely with growth leads, operations, project teams, and vendors to align on priorities and keep work unblocked
Once a program is in steady state, hand it off cleanly and take on the next one

Who We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in program operations, growth, recruiting or workforce operations, strategy and operations, or a similar role
You've owned a program end to end, from setting the strategy to executing it. You were the person accountable when something broke, and the person who fixed it.
You move comfortably between big-picture thinking and details, and you're as happy building a plan as you are working through a spreadsheet
Experience building and managing teams, ideally distributed or contractor-based
Strong judgment about prioritization when there's more work than time, and you know when to escalate and when to resolve on your own
Data-driven: comfortable defining metrics, digging into funnels, and making decisions from imperfect data. You can run your own analysis in SQL or Python.
High agency and ownership. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down, and you thrive when given room to build something from nothing.
You've built things with AI. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, Make, Retool, or Apps Script as a core part of how you work, and you have at least one workflow, automation, or tool you built that people actually used. We want to hear about what you've built.
Clear, concise writer and communicator. Much of this job happens over Slack and email, and clarity compounds across hundreds of interactions.

Strong candidates may also have

Experience scaling a program through rapid growth
A background in recruiting at scale, talent sourcing, growth marketing, or community building
Experience in marketplace, gig, or external workforce businesses

Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Project Manager of Lean Excellence

The Job You Will Perform

This position requires 90% travel

The Project Manager of Lean Excellence will propagate scalable operational improvement across the Containerboard business through lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution. The Lean Leader will serve as a hands-on change agent, partnering with mill teams to deploy lean tools and methodologies, lead Kaizen events, and embed standard work and problem-solving capabilities into daily operations.

The ideal candidate will have significant and relevant direct manufacturing experience using and leading continuous improvement tools, systems, and methodologies. The candidate must be a proven shop floor leader who is comfortable influencing others, coaching teams, and delivering measurable gains in safety, quality, delivery and cost.

Key Responsibilities

Implement lean tools such as 5S, Kaizen, Standard Work, Visual Management, SMED and Value Stream Mapping
Drive waste elimination, process flow optimization, and variation reduction
Facilitate structured problem solving using A3, DMAIC, 5-Why, RCFA, and similar methodologies
Deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost

Process Optimization & Execution

Use data to identify gaps in performance versus best practices and work with the mill team to execute an improvement plan
Document best practices and share improvements to leverage results
Understand and apply financial drivers and key performance indicators

Culture & Capability Building

Assist with implementing and managing systems that will sustain improvement efforts
Lead and coach CI events / kaizen through hands-on participation
Assist with developing and effectively delivering training materials in multiple formats to ensure team members throughout the organization are trained in CI concepts and philosophy
Evaluate and drive opportunities for appropriate CI and lean tool applications
Provide support, assistance, and communication to the mill leadership teams regarding CI initiatives

The Qualifications, Skills And Knowledge You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree preferred in business, engineering, operations management, or related field
Minimum 5 years of continuous manufacturing experience with proven change leadership skills
Demonstrated success utilizing and deploying lean tools
Strong analytical, facilitation, coaching and change leadership skills
Ability to influence without formal authority across multiple functions
Proficiency with Microsoft Office

About Us

International Paper offers a benefits package that includes health, welfare and retirement plans including Medical, Dental, Life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short-term and Long-term Disability, 401(k), Company-funded retirement contributions, Paid Time Off, Education & Development (including Tuition Reimbursement), Student Loan Repayment Assistance, and Voluntary Benefits including insurance for home, auto, vision and pets

Leadership training, promotional opportunities

The Impact You Will Make

We continue to build a better future for people, the planet, and our company! IP has been a good steward of sustainable practices across communities around the world for more than 125 years. Join our team and you’ll see why our team members say they’re Proud to be IP.

The Culture You Will Experience

International Paper promotes employee well-being by providing safe, caring and inclusive workplaces. We have team members all around the world with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. These are our strengths. We are committed to creating a culture where all individuals are respected, valued, engaged and have an opportunity to do their best work every day. We invite you to bring your uniqueness, creativity, talents, experiences, and safety mindset to be a part of our increasingly inclusive and diverse culture.

International Paper (NYSE: IP; LSE: IPC) creates sustainable packaging solutions that enable our customers, teammates and shareowners to thrive in an ever-changing world. We are a leader in corrugated packaging, partnering with customers across industries to protect what matters most, strengthen supply chains and create lasting value.
